messages:
Priya: Observed p95 latency regression in eu1 after last quant push at ~02:07 UTC. Short prompts (<=64) jump from ~210ms to ~1.0s.
Noel: any 5xxs? is it across all tenants?
Priya: latency-only. two enterprise tenants (tenant-acme, tenant-zen) tripped alerts. trace shows tokenizer kernel choosing quant path then CPU spike.
Taher (sre): sounds like kernel selector flipped. minimal mitigation is kernel selector revert for sequences <=64. can we limit canary to affected tenants first?
Priya: yes, we can do tenant-scoped canary for those two tenants, then expand. built image: registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-pin-03
DeployBot: [dry-run] registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-pin-03 validated in staging, smoke checks OK.
Ruth (release): release asks for a manual hold before global ramp and a changelog line. QA-Bot: please run quick perf smoke on tenant-acme fixture.
QA-Bot: perf-smoke result: tenant-acme p95 back to 230ms on hotfix image.
Taher: plan: dry-run -> tenant-scoped canary (tenant-acme,tenant-zen) at 100% of their traffic for 5m -> monitor predict.latency.p95 -> if ok, expand to 30% eu1 -> hold -> 100% eu1. auto-rollback if p95 > 400ms. Tag rollback: rollback:quant-pin-2026-03-21.
Priya: deploy command: ```/deploy start --cluster eu1 --image registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-pin-03 --tenant-canary tenant-acme,tenant-zen --canary-window 5m --auto-rollback-metric "predict.latency.p95" --rollback-threshold 400 --tag rollback:quant-pin-2026-03-21```
Noel: +1 from oncall if tenants-only first. Add #incidents notify and pager to Taher.
DeployBot: [deploy] tenant-scoped canary started for tenant-acme,tenant-zen.
DeployBot: [metric] tenant-acme predict.latency.p95 baseline=950ms current=240ms
Taher: tenant traces show tokenizer CPU normalized. alerts clearing.
DeployBot: [canary] tenant-scoped canary success. Holding before eu1 expansion.
Ruth: manual approval to expand to 30% eu1 granted. proceeding when Priya initiates.
Priya: expanding to 30% eu1 now.
DeployBot: [deploy] scaling to 30% eu1
DeployBot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 (eu1,10m) now=285ms
Taher: p95 stable, ready for final ramp.
Ruth: go to 100% and add release note: "hotfix: pinned kernel selector for short sequences to mitigate p95 latency regression; rolled eu1 100% 2026-03-21; rollback tag rollback:quant-pin-2026-03-21"
DeployBot: [deploy] rolling to 100% in eu1
DeployBot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 now=295ms
Noel: post-deploy checks: tenant alerts resolved, SLOs recovered. Great job.
Priya: added release note and changelog entry, closing thread. :tada:
